transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I came in because nothing feels like mine anymore. Stuff I used to care about—murals, running, basketball, even making a good drink at work—I just kind of stand there now like I don’t care about any of it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I don’t know… I mean, I haven’t really been tracking it like that. I just feel kind of low a lot, I guess. Hard to say “most of the day.”
Do you still enjoy things that used to make you happy, like murals, running, or basketball?
Not really. I mean… those things used to feel like mine, you know? Murals, going for a run, basketball, making a decent drink at work. Now I’m just kind of there, like I don’t care much either way.
Do you find that you don’t get any pleasure from things you used to enjoy, almost all the time?
Yeah… pretty much. I used to get something out of murals, running, basketball, even making a good drink. Now I just kind of stand there like… I don’t care about any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way, like you don’t care about things you used to enjoy?
About two months, I guess. Since the bar got bought out and… everything I’d been working toward kind of changed.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels since you started feeling this way?
Sleep, mostly. I’m tired when I lie down, but my head keeps going over stuff from work… every mistake. Then if I do fall asleep, I’m up around four or five and I can’t really get back to sleep.
Would you say that your mood has been consistently low, or that you’re not able to enjoy things even when good things happen?

Yeah… even if something’s supposed to be good, it doesn’t really land. I used to get excited about murals, going for a run, basketball, making a good drink… now I just kind of stand there like I don’t care. Nothing feels like mine anymore.
Have you had days where you felt like you were not good enough, or blamed yourself for things, or thought about not wanting to live anymore?

Yeah… I mean, I blame myself a lot. I keep thinking I let the younger bartenders down, and the artists I told I’d make room for. Like I wrecked their shot.

And… I don’t know. It feels like I deserve whatever happens to me for that.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to live anymore, or wishing you weren’t here?
I… I don’t know. I don’t really want to get into that. It’s just been… heavy.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt disconnected from the things you used to care about?

Yeah… I guess. This is kind of why I came in. Stuff I used to care about—murals, running, basketball, even making a good drink—it just doesn’t feel like mine anymore. I mostly just stand there like I don’t care.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things for two weeks or more?
I’m not sure. Maybe… I’ve had rough stretches before, but I don’t really keep track of how long they last. Two weeks, I don’t know.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things for two weeks or more?
I mean… like I said, I don’t really know. I’ve had times where I was down and didn’t care about much, but I couldn’t tell you if it was two weeks or… longer, or shorter. I don’t keep track like that.
Can you think back and tell me if you’ve had times before—maybe lasting a couple of weeks or longer—where you felt down and lost interest in the things you used to care about?

Yeah… I mean, I can’t really pin down the timing. But this is why I came in. Stuff I used to care about—murals, going for runs, basketball, making a decent drink—it just doesn’t feel like mine anymore. I’m kind of just… there. Like I don’t care.
Can you think back and tell me if you’ve had times before where you felt down and lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or longer?

I don’t know about before, exactly. What I know is now… that’s why I came in. The stuff I used to care about—murals, running, basketball, even making a good drink—it just doesn’t feel like mine anymore. I just kind of stand there like I don’t care.
Can you think back and tell me if there were definite times in the past when you felt down and lost interest in things for two weeks or more—times that were clearly separate from the current episode?
I… I can’t say definite, no. I’ve had rough stretches before, sure, but whether they were two weeks or clearly separate from this… I don’t really know.
Can you think back and tell me if you’ve had distinct times in the past—where you felt down and lost interest in things for at least two weeks—before this current period?

I don’t really know if I can separate it out like that. I came in because now… nothing feels like mine anymore. Murals, running, basketball, making a good drink—stuff I used to care about—I just kind of stand there like I don’t care.
Can you think back and tell me if you’ve had a period lasting at least two weeks in the past—clearly separate from the current time—when you felt down and lost interest in things?
I can’t really pin one down. I mean, I’ve had bad patches, but a clear two-week thing before this… I don’t know.

Can you think back and tell me if you’ve had a time before this current period—lasting at least two weeks—when you felt down and lost interest in things, and that time felt clearly separate from how you’re feeling now?
I really don’t know. I’ve had times that weren’t good, but I can’t point to one that was clearly separate like that.
Can you recall a time before this current period—lasting at least two weeks—when you felt down and lost interest in things, and that time felt clearly separate from how you’re feeling now?
I don’t think I can say that. I’ve had rough times, sure, but not something I can clearly separate out like that.
